body:
**Blocked by #167.**

`/settings/data-management` is a single button running `backfillOwnershipHistory()` — a one-off data repair, not a setting. It is not the same thing as `/settings/system/data`, which configures audit-log retention; the two only overlap in naming.

### Change

- Move the page to `/system/data-tools`; the action is unchanged.
- Remove the now-dead `dataManagementVisible` special case and its amber note card at `src/app/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx:38` — once the entry leaves `settings-nav.ts` it can never be true.
- Re-point `revalidatePath('/settings/system')` at `src/actions/system/prune-data.ts:78` to wherever pruning results now surface.
- Redirect the old path; keep its old ROUTE_PERMISSIONS entry, add one for the new path.

### Docs

`website/docs/administration/audit-logs-and-data-management.md`.

### Verify

`npm test`; run the backfill from its new location.

title: Settings IA slice 8: move the ownership backfill to /system/data-tools
